items.value_evidence: Upwork LinkedIn Specialists snippets list outreach and lead generation via Sales Navigator

items.name: College / scholarship application essay
items.one_line: A personal essay for undergraduate admission or a scholarship that reveals character through a specific story.
items.value_evidence: Admissions consulting is a paid market; Indian agencies sell admission essays alongside SOPs (SOP Expert).

sources.title: Common App: Announcing the 2026-2027 essay prompts
sources.supports: official personal-essay prompts for the 2026-27 cycle

sources.supports: Indian agency selling SOP, LOR and admission-essay writing for study abroad

items.note: Word caps differ (Common App, UCAS, each scholarship). Coaching and editing are fine; writing it for the applicant breaks most honour codes.

items.name: Comic / graphic-novel script
items.one_line: A page-by-page, panel-by-panel script telling an artist what to draw and a letterer what to letter.
items.value_evidence: Niche paid market: publishers, webtoon platforms, brand comics.
items.note: Format: PAGE n, Panel n description, then CAPTION / CHARACTER dialogue. Keep dialogue per panel short; page turns are reveal points. Vertical-scroll webtoons pace by scroll, not page.

items.name: Comment and reply writing (community management)
items.one_line: Replies to comments and DMs, and value-adding comments on other accounts' posts, written in the brand's voice to build conversation.
items.value_evidence: Bought as part of social media management retainers (Upwork lists social media managers as a hire category); no writing-only category found.

sources.title: Upwork: 14 Types of Freelance Writing Jobs and What They Pay (published 2026-01-21)
sources.supports: Upwork's own list of freelance writing job types with typical hourly rate bands charged on Upwork (blog/web content $15-$35/hr, content writer $15-$40/hr, ghostwriter $20-$45/hr, script writer $30-$56/hr, email & newsletter $15-$40/hr; newswriters $34-$62/hr citing Glassdoor) and project lists per type

items.note: Complaint replies move to private channels fast; never argue in public. Saved-reply libraries are a useful deliverable.

items.name: Reaction / commentary video script
items.one_line: Script or beat sheet for a video that reacts to, critiques or explains someone else's clip, trend or news moment.
items.value_evidence: Creator-written format with no dedicated marketplace category found on 2026-10-04.
items.note: Must add commentary that transforms the source; replaying others' footage with little added is reused content under YouTube's monetisation rules.

items.name: Community post (Discord / Circle / Skool / Facebook group)
items.one_line: Announcement, discussion prompt, weekly thread or welcome post inside a member community, written to get members talking to each other.
items.value_evidence: Paid community-management briefs on Upwork include writing announcements and engagement posts for Skool communities (example job, 2026); Fiverr's social facet lists Discord at only 5 gigs (2026-10-04).

items.name: Comparison article (X vs Y)
items.one_line: Head-to-head article comparing two products, tools or options on the criteria a buyer cares about, ending in who should pick which.
items.value_evidence: B2B SaaS SEO playbooks rank comparison pages among the bottom-of-funnel page types teams prioritise in 2026 (Optiseon, third-party); Google's review guidance asks reviews to compare against alternatives.

sources.title: Optiseon: B2B SaaS SEO in 2026: the playbook that drives pipeline
sources.supports: Agency playbook naming comparison, alternatives, integration and use-case pages as the bottom-of-funnel page types B2B SaaS teams prioritise in 2026 (third-party, low confidence)

sources.title: Google Search Central: Write high quality reviews (last updated 2025-12-10)
sources.supports: Google's own checklist for reviews: firsthand evidence, quantitative measurements, pros and cons, comparison to alternatives, justify 'best' picks; ranked lists must have enough useful content to stand on their own

items.note: Editorial/blog version; a vendor's own 'us vs them' conversion page is genre:comparison_page (genre_commercial). Must be fair when written by one of the vendors being compared; comparative claims about a competitor can trigger ASCI comparative-advertising rules.

items.name: Competitor comparison / alternatives page
items.one_line: Bottom-of-funnel page that compares the product with a named rival or targets '[rival] alternatives' searches.
items.value_evidence: SaaS copywriting agencies sell comparison and 'alternative' pages as a service line

items.name: Comparison table copy
items.one_line: Row and column labels, verdict cells and footnotes for a product comparison table on an affiliate or review page.
items.value_evidence: Bundled into affiliate and review articles (Google's review guidance expects comparisons with alternatives); no separate marketplace category.

sources.title: Google Search Central: Write high quality reviews (last updated 2025-12-10)
sources.supports: Google's own checklist for reviews: firsthand evidence, quantitative measurements, pros and cons, comparison to alternatives, justify 'best' picks; ranked lists must have enough useful content to stand on their own

items.note: Every cell must be verifiable and dated; prices change, so note the check date.

items.name: Condolence message
items.one_line: A short message of sympathy to a bereaved person or family, by card, letter, WhatsApp or official statement.
items.value_evidence: No meaningful paid market except official statements written by leaders' offices.
items.note: Name the person who died, one specific memory, an offer of concrete help. Avoid 'everything happens for a reason'. Leaders' condolence posts follow a set formal register in Hindi and English.

items.name: Cover letter
items.one_line: A short letter that connects a candidate's proof to one specific job and asks for the interview.
items.value_evidence: Fiverr runs a Cover Letter category; often sold bundled with resume writing.

sources.title: Fiverr Writing & Translation: Cover Letters
sources.supports: category exists on the Writing & Translation menu

items.note: Three to four short paragraphs: why this company, the one or two proofs that match the role, close with a clear ask. Never repeat the resume line by line.

items.name: Creator newsletter (personal / paid)
items.one_line: A creator's own recurring newsletter (often on Substack or beehiiv, free or paid) that turns followers into an owned audience.
items.value_evidence: Newsletter writers are hired to ghostwrite in the client's voice on Substack and beehiiv (Upwork newsletter-writer hire page).

sources.supports: Upwork runs a dedicated hire page for newsletter writers (curating news and links, editorial essays, Substack/beehiiv)

items.note: Voice consistency across issues matters more than any single issue; paid tiers need a clear promise of what subscribers get.
